near_dup_metric: RMS difference on 56x56 block means (0-255 scale)
note: Output of the 2026-10-17 draw (scripts later committed as tools/draw_pubmedclip_pins.py; the scan-order block came from its scan_order() step run separately). The near-duplicate guard is a COARSE screen: its threshold is the median within-test nearest-neighbour distance, so about half of any same-scan neighbours lie beyond it. The full fresh-to-exposed distance distribution was not saved by that run (min and median only); re-running the script writes it. Nothing here is a score.
